name: bird_hoot_fly_up
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this Hoot reference into one production key frame. Keep exactly the same pale tawny cream round owl, heart-shaped white facial disc, amber eyes, grey-brown speckled wings, tiny star-patterned blue nightcap, NO ear tufts. Preserve the same square canvas, BODY SCALE and torso location, camera, feather texture and warm upper-left lighting. Flying key frame: exactly TWO wings swept up above shoulder level with spread feathers, BOTH feet tucked up tight against belly with curled toes, no planted legs, torso position unchanged. Whole bird safely within canvas, never scale body down to fit wings. Transparent alpha background, single bird, no floor, shadow, border, text or decorations.
